literal: Even within doing good, there is mistake, if [one] does not do [it] having known each person's nature.
translation: Even in doing good, failure can occur if one does not act after understanding the specific nature of the individuals involved.
modern: ஒவ்வொருவருடைய குணத்தையும் அறிந்து அதற்கேற்பச் செய்யாவிட்டால், நன்மை செய்வதிலும் தவறு நேர்ந்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet warns that even well-intentioned actions can go wrong and result in failure. Doing good is not enough on its own; one must understand the unique character and temperament of the person receiving the help or involved in the action. If we act without this understanding, the good deed may backfire, turn into a mistake, or cause unintended harm. Therefore, thoughtful action requires analyzing both the deed and the nature of the people affected by it.
